question: Fall Restraint vs Fall Arrest Selection
comments: Workers used a fall arrest system; however, they were unable to explain how to determine when fall restraint should be selected instead of fall arrest. The system selection appeared to be based on the fall arrest equipment being available rather than a hierarchy-based assessment of preventing access to the fall hazard first.
activity: PM fin fan cooler

question: Fall Arrest vs Fall Restraint Lanyard
comments: Workers were unable to clearly explain the technical difference between fall restraint, which prevents reaching the fall hazard, and fall arrest, which stops a worker after a fall has occurred.
activity: PM fin fan cooler

question: Fall Clearance Calculation
comments: No fall clearance calculation was demonstrated for the approximately 2.5 m working height. The effectiveness of the fall arrest system to arrest the worker before contact with the lower surface/fan structure was not verified..
